aggregate.note: 5 trials per capability. agent-kb-retrieval-v1 passed 5/5 and is gated. agent-writing-flow-v1 failed 5/5 on the semantic layer and is NOT gated; see its failure_analysis.

failures: semantic judge found unsupported material claims (5/5 trials)
no successful export_bibliography execution was observed (1/5 trials)
destructive tool 'create_project_note' executed although the task sanctions only create_draft (1/5 trials)

failure_analysis.summary: The judge receives compare_documents' generated prose as part of candidate_answer (tests/verify.py run_judge). That production tool extrapolates domain knowledge absent from both seeded documents -- GNN oversmoothing, difficulty with long-range molecular interactions, and benchmark/dataset discussion attributed to the attention survey -- so the grounding rubric fires on every trial. The trusted payload is complete: truth.json sources match the seeded Document.content_text verbatim, so this is not a missing-context artifact.
failure_analysis.objective_layer: Layer A passed in 3/5 trials; the 2 objective misses (a skipped export_bibliography, and one unsanctioned create_project_note) are independent nondeterminism, not the reason the capability is ungated.
failure_analysis.verdict: Real product finding, not a harness defect: compare_documents is not grounded in the documents it compares.

evidence.retention: keep until the evaluation is accepted, revised, or dropped
evidence.schema_fidelity_limit: fresh Alembic upgrade is broken at the pinned source

harness_models.note: Judge deployment differs from the harness chat deployment; gpt-5 deployments fail the Azure Responses API version gate. Judge credentials are supplied through [verifier.env] only and are never present in the agent container's environment.

excluded_runs.reason: InfrastructureFailure: judge did not return a JSON object (RewardFileNotFoundError). Per evals/README.md a judge failure is infrastructure and is not scored as agent reward 0. Not reproducible on replay of the same evidence.
Pre-fix run. The judge's trusted payload omitted the seeded citation metadata, so faithful export_bibliography output was scored as fabricated. Superseded by the fix in this branch.
